nights.title: SOMBR - You Are The Reason Tour
nights.name: Sombr
nights.extract: Shane Michael Boose, known professionally as Sombr, is an American singer-songwriter and musician.

nights.title: Arlo McKinley
nights.name: Arlo McKinley
nights.extract: Arlo McKinley is an American country singer and singer/songwriter. He has released three albums, the most recent release being This Mess We're In on John Prine’s record label Oh Boy Records, released July 15, 2022.

nights.title: Alyssa Grace
nights.name: Alyssa Grace
nights.extract: Alyssa Grace Proffitt is an American singer-songwriter based in California. She made her recording debut in 2026 with "Dog with a Bone" and gained wider recognition through the singles "Picking Petals" and "Bloodstream".
